C_REVIEW_DESCENT.statement: The geometric descent dossier is assessed against the designated des:descent statement, its actual proof, citations and old matching independent judgments.

C_REVIEW_INTEGER.statement: The old arithmetic formalization, fidelity, toolchain and compiler provenance are assessed without presenting them as geometric formalization.

C_REVIEW_CUBIC.statement: The cubic finite check and its typed adapter and standalone-checker evidence are assessed at their actual finite scope.

C_REVIEW_OUTLINE.statement: Every undeveloped old classification-programme claim has a concrete disposition and dependency boundary; none is silently promoted from the local descent proof.
